hilford-backpack.descriptionHtml:
Description:

The Hilford rugged yet stylish leather backpack is crafted from high-quality cowhide, offering a perfect blend of durability and sophistication. The rich brown finish gives it a classic look, while multiple pockets and secure buckle closures add a touch of functionality. Ideal for daily commutes, travel, or as a unique accessory, this backpack caters to both style and utility.

Features:

  • Outer Shell: Real Leather
  • Leather Type: Cowhide
  • Leather Finish: Distressed
  • Inner Shell: Satin Lining
  • Colour: Dark Brown
  • Bag Type: Backpack
  • Pockets: Two side zippered pockets and one front pocket with flap cover
  • Strap Type: Adjustable shoulder straps with buckles
  • Closure Style: Dual buckle strap with drawstring inner closure
  • Usage: Travel, Office, Casual outings

Product Care:

If your backpack gets stained, clean it at your earliest. If you are a regular user, we recommend using professional cleaning services.

Key Points:

  • Gentle dry clean only
  • Do not wash
  • Do not bleach
  • Do not iron
  • Do not tumble dry
